history.summary: Valid Codex 0.144.1 reasoning, compaction, and image input items are rejected before provider dispatch; docs also overstate npm evidence.
Codex optional fields and id-less compaction continuation pass, but rs1 optional-reasoning carriers are silently dropped by Claude request translation.
All four rs1 request carriers pass, but non-stream Responses reasoning with an empty summary text still loses its opaque carrier.
Aggregate-empty carrier cases pass, but stream/non-stream reasoning diverges on leading whitespace and multi-summary separators.
Framing equivalence passes, but reasoning_text.delta is dropped and missing/duplicate output-item lifecycle can lose or duplicate reasoning while reporting success.
Reasoning lifecycle and bounded-state fixes pass, but valid Codex completed/incomplete terminals without response.status are rejected by the bridge.
Statusless terminals pass, but the bridge still requires response.created.model, accepts terminal id conflicts, and coerces malformed usage to zero.
